geometry_source_repositories.source_name: Cartório de Registro de Imóveis de Taubaté (1º CRI)
geometry_source_repositories.public_accessibility: RESTRICTED_ON_DEMAND (Requires paid certidão or formal in-person archival request; not open bulk web indexed)
geometry_source_repositories.description: Legal depository of the approved subdivision blueprint (Planta de Loteamento) and individual property deeds (matrículas) containing registered lot perimeters, lot numbers, and block layouts.
geometry_source_repositories.achieved_open_level: GEOM_1 (Textual citations in secondary legal notices only)

geometry_source_repositories.source_name: Prefeitura Municipal de Taubaté - Arquivo de Planejamento Urbano (SEPLAN)
geometry_source_repositories.public_accessibility: ADMINISTRATIVE_ON_DEMAND (Processos de Aprovação de Loteamento via 1Doc / SEPLAN; macrozoning is open, but subdivision blueprint files are archived physically or within administrative dockets)
geometry_source_repositories.description: Municipal archive holding historical subdivision dossiers and infrastructure approval maps.
geometry_source_repositories.achieved_open_level: GEOM_0 (Open geodata provides macrozoning only; zero parcel drawings)

geometry_source_repositories.source_name: Tribunal de Justiça de SP (TJSP) - Laudos Periciais de Avaliação Imobiliária
geometry_source_repositories.description: Civil and fiscal execution dockets and auction dossiers (Franklin Leilões, Mega Leilões, Valero Leilões) transcribing CRI matrícula perimeters.
geometry_source_repositories.achieved_open_level: GEOM_2 (Describes lot dimensions and street frontage, but lacks full block lot arrangement diagrams)

geometry_source_repositories.description: High-precision planar vector polygons of physical road blocks (PRB-0326, PRB-0401, PRB-0419, PRB-0746, etc.). Does not natively contain historical subdivision block letters or numbered lot boundaries.
geometry_source_repositories.achieved_open_level: GEOM_2 (Physical road blocks completely mapped, but unlinked to internal lot boundaries)
